shell.title: The shell begins before the charger.
shell.fact: A 2017 charger study found that making 1 kg of recycled PC plastic caused about 30% of the resource-depletion impact of virgin PC.
shell.note: A material comparison, not a measurement of this charger. Its exact plastic has not been identified.

board.title: A small board carries a long history.
board.fact: Making the circuit board and casing drove pre-manufacturing impacts in that study. This stage contributed over 98% in four impact categories.
board.note: The four categories were acidification, eutrophication, ozone depletion and photochemical oxidant formation. This is not 98% of all impacts.

plug.title: The cost keeps flowing during use.
plug.fact: In the same study, use caused 70% of global-warming impact and 94.4% of resource-depletion impact, mostly from electricity consumption.
plug.note: These figures describe a different charger under that study's assumptions. They are not readings from this charging experiment.

contacts.title: Taking it apart is not the end.
contacts.fact: Only 22.3% of global electronic waste was documented as formally collected and recycled in 2022. Separating a few parts does not mean they will all be recovered.
contacts.source: ITU / UNITAR, The Global E-waste Monitor 2024.
contacts.note: This is a global e-waste figure, not a charger-specific recycling rate. The future disposal route of this object is unknown.

wires.title: A short connection. A longer material story.
wires.fact: Electronics contain metals that take energy to extract and manufacture. Recovering these materials through proper collection can keep them in circulation.
wires.source: US EPA, Electronics Donation and Recycling, 2025.
wires.imageAlt: The looped wire component from the disassembled charger
wires.note: The wire metal in this object has not been identified. The source describes electronics generally.

lights.title: Full does not mean switched off.
lights.fact: A light can show that charging has finished while the charger stays connected. Hama lists 0.0582 W of no-load power for one charger's adapter.
lights.source: Hama Delta Ovum LCD operating instructions, p. 5.
lights.imageAlt: Three indicator lights on the reference universal charger
lights.note: A published figure for Hama's adapter, not a reading from this older charger. Its exact LED codes are unverified.

back.title: There is no invisible bin.
back.fact: The world generated 62 million tonnes of electronic waste in 2022. A casing is one small part of a much larger waste stream.
back.source: ITU / UNITAR, The Global E-waste Monitor 2024.
back.note: A global total, not this object's footprint. Taking the casing off does not guarantee it will be recycled.
